meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会派子代理查文档，再产出按阶段划分的计划。每步含做什么、参考文档、怎么验证、别踩的坑。
howto.when: 当你要求规划某个功能、任务或多步实施时触发，尤其是在执行 do 之前。

say.text: 帮我规划实现用户注册的步骤。
say.note: Claude 会先查文档再给出分阶段计划。

say.text: 制定一个把旧代码迁移到新版 API 的计划。
say.note: 它会先做文档发现，列出每个阶段。

say.text: 用 do 执行前，先给我一个详细实施计划。
say.note: 会先输出计划，再考虑执行。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planner. It launches subagents to read docs, then outputs a phased plan. Each phase lists what to do, doc references, verification steps, and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: When asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan the steps to implement user registration.
say_en.note: Claude will check docs first, then give a phased plan.

say_en.text: Make a plan to migrate old code to the new API.
say_en.note: It will do documentation discovery and list phases.

say_en.text: Before running do, give me a detailed implementation plan.
say_en.note: It will output the plan first, before executing.
